_comment: The closing limit: every bias check can pass and incidence is still out of reach for a case-control study - the door into L05's cohort.

stem.en: On the live case, all four bias checks pass and the odds ratio stands at 13.2. Which question about tank cleaning does this study still have no way to answer?

text.en: Whether the link between cleaning and the tumour is larger than chance would produce
Whether the men with the tumour cleaned tanks more often than the comparison men did
Whether the cases and the controls were comparable in age
How many of all the plant's tank cleaners develop the tumour each year

explanation.en: The table answers the first two: the exposure rates, 70 per cent among the cases and 15 per cent among the controls, differ far beyond chance. Matching on age answered the third before the table was drawn. But incidence needs all the plant's tank cleaners counted and followed forward, and a case-control study assembles no such group; that is the limit stamped on the odds-ratio card, and the door into the next file.

hints.en: Ask which question needs a number the study never set out to collect.
